name: looop
workflow_mapping: looop is the scheduler itself. This adapter is standalone only: it is not registered as a scheduler lane and must not be scheduled by looop. Claude acts as product manager in owner conversations; Builder and Reviewer run on DeepSeek Harness through looop-agents/dsh-sandboxed in /home/agentdev/projects/looop-<name> worktrees, never in the live checkout. Roles are the repository's own default-roles files (the default-role installer refuses the looop checkout). bin/ is canonical; .agent/tools links to it. Changes to live systemd units follow docs/cutover.md with explicit operator approval; data/, logs/, caches, credentials and machine bindings are never committed. WOS automation disabled, DS1 human-only.
